card.name: Command-line option letters after a dash
card.fires_on: The single letter after a hyphen in command-line flags such as -k, -f, -R or -l in Unix manuals and tutorials. Weaker hits fall on digits inside long numbers and on odd capitalised fragments.

modes.label: Option letter after dash
modes.description: A one-letter flag following a hyphen in a shell command or man-page text.

modes.label: Digits in listings
modes.description: A digit inside a long number such as a file size, page number or hash in technical text.
